intro.heading: Our Approach
intro.text: At Crayola Design Studio, every space begins with how light moves through volume. We craft environments grounded in sensory warmth, material integrity, and architectural precision.

servicesTeaser.heading: What We Craft
servicesTeaser.text: From architectural concepts to photorealistic realization — every detail resolved.

cta.heading: Ready to bring your vision to life?

whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are
whoWeAre.text: Crayola Design Studio is an architectural, interior design, and ArchViz practice operating across Bangalore, Trichy, Hyderabad, and Coimbatore. We partner with homeowners, developers, and architects to visualize and build spaces that balance aesthetic grandeur with quiet daily livability.

philosophy.heading: Our Philosophy
philosophy.text: We believe luxury is not excess — it is restraint, proportion, and the unhurried beauty of authentic materials. From custom-milled louvered entries and fluted acoustic headboards to natural stone facades, we design spaces that stand with timeless poise.

process.title: Discovery & Space Planning
process.description: We analyze your lifestyle rhythm, spatial flow, and site orientation to establish precise functional zoning and circulation plans.

process.title: 3D Massing & Elevation Study
process.description: We translate programmatic needs into sculptural volumes, facade detailing, and daylight studies using photorealistic 3D digital twins.

process.title: Materialization & Lighting Design
process.description: We select authentic textures — brushed limestone, smoked oak, natural linen, and bespoke fluting — layered with indirect architectural illumination.

process.title: Photoreal Walkthrough & Execution
process.description: Clients experience 4K ArchViz and interactive 360° virtual tours before construction begins, ensuring uncompromising execution on site.

interiorDesign.heading: Interior Design
interiorDesign.oneLiner: Custom space planning and aesthetic detailing for rooms and luxury homes.
interiorDesign.description: Tailored interior atmospheres crafted for quiet living. We engineer custom joinery, acoustic fluting, and warm layered lighting to turn every room into an architectural haven.

exteriorDesign.heading: Exterior Design
exteriorDesign.oneLiner: Elevation options, facade detailing, and color schemes before construction begins.
exteriorDesign.description: We define the boundary between your home and the world. Sculptural portal frames, curvilinear balcony profiles, and integrated facade lighting establish unforgettable street presence.

archViz.heading: 3D ArchViz & Walkthroughs
archViz.oneLiner: Cinematic 3D visualizations — walk through your future space before it is built.
archViz.description: Experience accurate sunlight behavior, material reflections, and spatial depth. Our 4K cinematic walkthroughs and 360° virtual tours eliminate guesswork before a single brick is laid.

intro.heading: Begin Your Project
intro.text: Operating across Bangalore, Trichy, Hyderabad, and Coimbatore. Connect with our principal designers to start shaping your next space.
